notes.title: Halloween Update & Developer Livestream
notes.content:
[b]Steam Deck Compatibility[/b]

The Alien Cube has been updated to support Steam Deck.
You can delve into this Lovecraftian horror adventure wherever you are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/2267b0f248f7e2977d5365a6a7262871c22bbcde.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam Cloud added[/b]

The Alien Cube now supports Steam Cloud so you can keep your savegames on your gaming devices!

[b]Halloween in-game Event[/b] 

The Alien Cube gets into the Halloween mood also this year. Get ready to explore the different areas of the game to find hidden pumpkins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/9de34df226733124cfd88b99e5021c9f4de1fadd.jpg[/img]

[b]Watch the developer play[/b]

This year’s Halloween Event I’m going to simulcast The Alien Cube to the store page here on Steam and my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyKtNyEy6CSV998TtyWfr0w]YouTube channel[/url] while chatting with you guys!
I’ll play the game and will talk about game’s development, future plans and my next project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/cfed5b622dcb05f5f30cda20a83af5900346423d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/75a7ec38a9ad3f45b2666344c70871c08b231273.jpg[/img]

Everyone is welcome, I’ll be happy to answer your questions ;)

The Alien Cube Livestream starts on October 26th at 8PM CEST.


If you want to be up-to-date with the latest news and events on my games, follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/GuzzoProds]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.instagram.com/guzzoproductions/?hl]Instagram[/url].

notes.title: LOVECRAFT EVENT & NEW GAME REVEAL
notes.content:
The Lovecraft Tag event on Steam has just begun! 
To celebrate this special moment, the game has been updated with an in-game event as a tribute to the most important source of inspiration for my games: H.P. Lovecraft.
He was a writer of horror and weird stories, born in Providence in 1890.
He is mostly known for the creation of the Cthulhu Mythos. In his tales he made frequent references to ancient and powerful gods called the "Great Old Ones". 
Lovecraft’s macabre imagination has been inspiring for my works, in particular his ability to convey a feeling of insignificance that characterizes man's place in the universe. His protagonists have to deal with a horrifying truth that should not be revealed to humanity.

[h3]THE INGAME EVENT:[/h3]
It consists in a new main menu theme and a secret drawing that I’ve hidden somewhere in the game. Search everywhere and find it!
This event will last one month.

[h3]GAME UPDATE:[/h3]
The game has also been updated with bug fixes and general improvements.

[h3]MY NEXT PROJECT:[/h3]
Are you curious to see something about my next game? Here are a few sneak peeks for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/f580275fbccb7428b94251b38b8fc8c04e565be5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/4ff2c8a8c99ba8b8fabfb7cef36f626a6d33baeb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/eb1f99b6c6e3958d0f754784d61549e0cefb83bb.jpg[/img]

Those scenarios are in very early stages as I’m currently developing them, so keep in mind that they are not representing the final quality of the game. 
Leave a comment and let me know what you think! ;)
Like my previous games, it is a first person horror adventure with a strong focus on Lovecraftian vibes. It’s a very ambitious project and I can’t wait to share with you a lot more in the next future!

[h3]HELP ME GROWING THE COMMUNITY:[/h3]
As a solo dev, it would be amazing for me if you could help me growing the community around my games by following my Steam Developer Page and my socials: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GuzzoProductions]STEAM DEVELOPER PAGE[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/GuzzoProds]TWITTER[/url]
[url=https://instagram.com/guzzoproductions/]INSTAGRAM[/url]

A big thank to everyone!
-Alessandro

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
CHANGELOG:

-Various bugs fixed and improvements in all levels

-Horse statuette puzzle improved
